\(\dfrac{dP}{dt}=0.007P^2(t)-0.04P(t)G(t)+\sqrt{G(t)-\int\limits_{0}^{T}P(t)dt}\)

\(\begin{equation*}\dfrac{dP}{dt}=0.007P^2(t)-0.04P(t)G(t)+\sqrt{G(t)-\int_{0}^{T}P(t)dt}\end{equation*}\)

\(\left.\dfrac{\partial f_1}{\partial P}\right|_{(P_0,G_0)} \)

\(\left[\begin{array}{c}\dfrac{dP}{dt} \\ 
\dfrac{dG}{dt} \end{array}\right] = \left[\begin{array}{cc}
  \left.\dfrac{\partial f_1}{\partial P}\right|_{(P_0,G_0)} & \left.\dfrac{\partial f_1}{\partial G}\right|_{(P_0,G_0)}\\
  \\
  \left.\dfrac{\partial f_2}{\partial P}\right|_{(P_0,G_0)} & \left.\dfrac{\partial f_2}{\partial G}\right|_{(P_0,G_0)}
  \end{array}\right] \left[\begin{array}{c}P-P_0 \\ G-G_0 \end{array}\right]\)
